name: 视频有界抽帧证据
eligibility_checks: frame count and timestamps are bounded
assumptions: ffprobe duration and requested timestamps refer to the locked media bytes
human_gates: confirm explicit timestamps or bounded sampling strategy
semantically review frames before visual claims
diagnostics: duration parsing, timestamp bounds, FFmpeg return codes, frame hashes, and failures
allowed_claims: the recorded frame was extracted from the declared source timestamp under the declared parameters
forbidden_claims: bounded frames represent the full video
a failed timestamp may be silently omitted
